title: Super Mario World

masks.why: the status bar and the title's wooden frame are BG3 drawn in front (BGMODE $09) and laid out for 256 columns

issues: Enemies and coins appear 16-32 pixels past the SNES edge: the game creates its objects as they come near the SNES picture, so in the side columns they pop in.
At the start of a level the left side is empty: the level begins at the SNES picture's left edge.
Levels whose water or clouds are BG3 drawn in front (the layer-3 tides) lose that layer in the side columns.
Fast CPU removes the game's slowdown, so its own timing changes: risky.
